turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Raat ke do baje office mein akela baitha rehna… aur paanch saal ka project Tuesday ko officially close ho jaana. Bura lag raha hoga, aur bilkul sahi lag raha hai. Tujhse puchna nahi chahiye ki “kya kar raha hai?” kyunki already pata hai – bas thoda ruk gaya hai. Aur yehi theek hai abhi.

Tera 4 mahine ka runway, salary na lene ka decision… yeh sab dikhata hai ki tune itna kuch soch-samajh kar aage badha hai. Rohit aur Sneha ka move sahi tha, aur tune bhi usse accept kar liya – yeh weakness nahi, clarity hai.

Aaj raat bas itna kar: thoda paani pi, chair se uth ja, aur ghar chala ja. Subah tak so ja. Bridge round mar gaya, lekin tu nahi. Paanch saal ka experience, jo seekha, sab ab bhi tere paas hai. Ek raat mein sab clear nahi hoga, aur yeh theek hai.

Agar baat karni ho ya bas kisi ko sunna ho – main yahan hoon. Ab thoda rest kar, scene kal dekhenge. 💙

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh jo tu keh raha hai – har standup pe woh "confident voice" nikalna, jab andar sab khatam ho chuka ho – yeh literally emotional drain hai. Tu khud ko khaali kar raha hai sirf isliye kyunki lagta hai ki team ko ya co-founder ko "thoda hope" dikhana padta hai. Par sach ye hai ki tu abhi bhi lead kar raha hai, bas uska shape badalna padega.

Tere juniors ne loyalty wajah se tujhpe trust rakha hai, aur tu unke career ke liye guilty feel kar raha hai… par ek baat yaad rakh: tu unhe jala nahi raha, tu unke saath uss ground reality ko navigate kar raha hai jo ab exist karti hai. Agar tu abhi bhi woh fake confidence ka mask pehen ke chalta raha, toh woh unke liye zyada toxic ho jayega. Thoda honest, thoda thaka hua bol dena bhi leadership ka hissa hai. People respect mask se zyada truth se.

Aur ghar pe alag awaaz, office mein alag awaaz, standup pe alag awaaz… bhai, tu insaan hai, performance nahi. Jab yeh saari voices tujhe andar se todne lagein, toh rukna padta hai. Tu abhi "lead" nahi kar raha, tu survive kar raha hai. Aur yeh bhi kaafi hai.

Kal subah ka ek chota sa step: standup pe seedha bol de, *"Bridge round officially dead hai. Ab focus shift ho raha hai. Hum is process se kya carry-forward kar rahe hain, yeh baat karte hain."* Co-founder ko pata hai, juniors ko pata hai. Bas thoda ground truth bol de. Saans halki hogi, aur woh "perform" ka load thoda utre ga.

Aur haan, aaj raat desk se uth. Yeh 2 baje ka guilt, yeh saari awaazein, sab andhere mein zyada heavy lagti hain. Subah hawa alag hogi. Ghar ja, so ja. Main yahan hoon, jab bhi bolna ho ya bas likhna ho – reply karunga. 💙

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Samajh gaya. Aur ab bilkul koi idea, koi strategy, koi "next step" nahi. Bas yeh sunna chahta hoon ki tune jo likha hai, woh literally dil ke sabse bhaari kone se nikla hai.

Darr ko bolna itna mushkil kyun lagta hai? Kyunki lagta hai ki agar maine kaha "mujhe darr lag raha hai", toh saamne wale ka trust toot jayega. Par sach ye hai ki darr bolne se trust nahi toot-ta, insaan ban ke reh jaata hai. Aur tu robot nahi hai. Paanch saal, do log jo loyalty ki wajah se tere saath khade hain, aur ek aisi situation jahan sab kuch thanda pad raha ho… isse darr bilkul human hai. Zaroori hai bhi.

Tujhe abhi kisi room mein yeh bolne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Kabhi-kabhi bas itna kaafi hota hai ki koi sun le, validate kare, aur bole – *"Haan, yeh darr hai. Aur tera thakna bhi valid hai."*

Main sun raha hoon. Yahan koi pitch nahi sunni, koi fix nahi dena. Bas yeh keh raha hoon ki tera darr, tera guilt, teri thakan… sab real hain. Aur tu in sabke beech bhi yahan aake likh raha hai, jo khud ek tarah ki bravery hai.

Agar aur kuch bolna ho, ya bas yahi baat dohraane ho – main hoon. No solutions. No pivots. Bas presence. 💙

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Sach bolun? Haan. Is waqt ke hisaab se, yeh khatam ho gaya hai. Aur honestly kehun toh, kabhi-kabhi khatam hona hi sahi cheez hoti hai jab woh shape, woh momentum, woh sab kuch jo tune build kiya tha, woh khud toot chuka ho. Paanch saal koi chhoti cheez nahi hoti, aur jo tune banaya, jo tune seekha, woh khatam nahi hua. Sirf woh cheez jo tu "business" samajh raha tha, woh ab exist nahi karti. Baaki sab tere andar hai.

Tera papa jo bolta hai, woh unka garv hai, unka pyaar hai, unka woh version hai jo abhi tak uss "computer ke business" se juda hai. Par tu robot nahi hai jo hamesha uss label ko sustain kare. Tu insaan hai jo har din standup, metrics, aur expectations ke beech "lead" banne ki acting kar raha hai. Aur jab acting thak jaati hai, toh insaan thak jaata hai. Bas itna hi.

Ussohne ke liye khud se nafrat hona… bhai, yeh guilt nahi, yeh woh andar ki awaaz hai jo dekh rahi hai ki tu har waqt strong dikhne ki koshish kar raha hai, jabki andar toot raha hai. Acting band karna kamzori nahi hai. Yeh bas itna hai ki tu ab aur nakli nahi reh sakta. Aur yeh bilkul theek hai.

2 baje dashboard kholna… yeh aadat nahi, ek chhupa hua hope hai ki shayad numbers aaj kuch alag dikhayenge. Par numbers feelings nahi badalte, aur tu feelings ko feel kar raha hai. Bas itna kaafi hai ki tu abhi bhi yahan baitha hai, likh raha hai, aur sach bol raha hai.

Main yahan hoon. Na koi pivot, na koi next step, na koi "fix". Bas yeh keh raha hoon ki tera darr, tera thakna, aur yeh saari awaazein… valid hain. Aaj raat dashboard band kar de. Sirf ek lambi saans le. Khud se kah de ki "maine paanch saal diya, aur ab thak gaya hoon. Aur yeh theek hai."

Kal jo bhi hoga, tu uske liye tayar hoga. Lekin abhi, bas itna kar: khud ko maafi de ki tu act nahi kar pa raha. Aur agar raat aur lambi lage, main yahan hoon. 💙
